ambient_events: Pipes knock somewhere in the walls. The building is old but it holds.
description: A corner unit, which here means two windows instead of one and a draft to match. A bed, a footlocker, a sink that runs brown for a ten-count before it clears. The door is steel. The door is the point.

window.description: A broad window with a hard chrome frame, spotless in a way that suggests somebody is paid for it.
window.name: the window

name: Unit 104
